title: Meet a neighbour
goal: Greet someone, meet them and say goodbye.

turns.goal: It is morning. Return your neighbour's greeting.
turns.why: Bom dia is a greeting for the morning.

turns.goal: You are meeting for the first time. Return the greeting.
turns.why: Muito prazer is a natural reply when someone introduces themselves.

turns.goal: You will see each other tomorrow. Say goodbye.
turns.why: Até amanhã means See you tomorrow. Até logo means See you later.

title: Find the station
goal: Ask for directions, ask again and thank someone.

turns.goal: You need the station. Ask this person where it is.
turns.why: Onde fica…? asks where a place is. A estação means the station.

turns.goal: You did not catch the direction. Ask them to repeat.
turns.why: Pode repetir, por favor? politely asks someone to say something again.

turns.goal: Now you understand. Thank the person for helping.
turns.why: Obrigado is used by a male speaker. A female speaker normally says Obrigada.

title: Help a traveller
goal: Welcome someone, give a direction and reply to thanks.

turns.goal: It is afternoon. Greet the traveller who approaches you.
turns.why: Desculpe gets someone's attention politely. Boa tarde greets them in the afternoon.

turns.goal: The station is on the right. Give the traveller that direction.
turns.why: À direita means on the right. À esquerda means on the left.

turns.goal: The traveller thanks you. Reply politely.
turns.why: De nada is a natural response to Obrigado or Obrigada.
